To answer Question 1 successfully, students must apply the Mathematical Practices
for AP Calculus as described below:
▶ ▶ Engage in reasoning with theorems (MPAC 1) in order to find the derivative of
volume with respect to time as well as in using the Fundamental Theorem of
Calculus to find for particular values of .
▶ ▶ Connect the concept (MPAC 2) of derivative to both the concept of optimization and
the concept of slope of a tangent line.
▶ ▶ Use proper notational fluency (MPAC 5) to communicate (MPAC 6) the process of
finding the values for and and to interpret the meaning of .
▶ ▶ Use algebraic manipulation (MPAC 3) to substitute into the expression for
and find the equation of a tangent line.
